classes.name: Ranger
classes.description: 2 mana: Deal 2 damage to the enemy hero.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: 2 mana: Deal 1 damage to an enemy.

landmarks.name: Family home
landmarks.dialogue: Your family tends the luminous resin garden. A small creature has been eating the crop. Take your companion east and bring it back safely in a card.

landmarks.name: Old friend
landmarks.dialogue: Your companion is a Legendary, but it is only beginning to grow. Let your Finch and Guard help it. Cards are companions, not just prizes.

landmarks.name: Resin garden
landmarks.dialogue: Luminous resin keeps our lamps burning. Beyond the shore, whole fleets trade for a single harvest. The Crab clearing is just east.

landmarks.name: Crab clearing
landmarks.dialogue: A Resin Crab guards the garden path. First victory: its creature card and 2 luminous resin. Rematches are practice.

landmarks.name: Campfire
landmarks.dialogue: The fire is warm. Rest to restore your health, then prepare your deck for another adventure.

landmarks.name: Lookout dock
landmarks.dialogue: Black sails gather on the horizon. Your friend whispers about monarchs whose power shapes entire islands. One day, home will need more than a brave little companion. More islands are still to come.
